decision_rationale: The sections describe Exai-1 as a multimodal foundation model pretrained on 13,014 blood samples, with masked language modeling and a transformer decoder to reconstruct cfRNA abundances. This supports both a genuinely generative architecture and foundation-model-like broad pretraining/applicability.
